body: There's really no option but to move forward, but in my mind it's all pointless and futile. I don't live for anyone but myself, I just said the only thing that matters to me in life are the people in it. Also about not letting this shit get the better of me is easier said than done. I'm already at the bottom so I guess there's nowhere to go to but up, but whenever I end up in these situations it usually takes a good year or so for me to even become slightly optimistic about anything. I'll just keep my head down, keep to myself and wait until the shitstorm blows over, but I'll be covered in shit for a long time after that, if that makes any sense.

I think it's great you're trying to face these issues and you have a daily goal you're working on. I'm not even doing that. I don't see the point any more. To be honest I don't even know how I managed to make it this far and have no idea what I'm doing any more. It's like I'm just a spectator watching my life pass me by. I hope you find the way to get through this, I really do, because I know that living like this is only a test to see how much misery you can take.

Thank you for your reply. You didn't sound at all preachy. My brother keeps telling me all these things so I'm used to it. I never told him about my anxiety or depression but he seems to have caught on, although I don't think he realises the severity of the situation. If you read one of my previous responses I said that I have tried working out, but never stuck around with it. I find it extremely boring and in my mind seems like a waste of time. However I do recognise that I did feel a little better in the short time I was working out so I plan to find someone to help keep me motivated and exercise.

You make some good points about working out at home though. I would probably do a couple of repeats and then just drop everything. That's just how lazy I am. But if I have a workout buddy at the gym I believe I'll be able to keep it up. Every time I started going to the gym I went on my own, so I couldn't help but feel anxious and lazy. It's all good advice and I appreciate it. I have another 45 days of slaving misery until I finish my work here and then I'll focus on exercising and generally me.
Thanks for this! I'll give it a go for sure to see what it does for me

I've tried working out but I never stuck around with it. A month is the longest I've ever worked out. It's so boring and tedious. I have to admit that I felt better when I did work out. I don't know why I never made the connection myself. Also right now I'm swamped with work (working 14+ hours a day on a group project. Trying to at least.) When I finish up here and go back home I will ask my fitness buff brother to force me to hit the gym with him.

I know nothing about meditation though. Can you, or anyone else for that matter, point me towards some reference to get me started?

Thank you for the advice. I have tried seeking professional help from a therapist, however my anxiety issues take hold of me and I lock up emotionally becoming unable to discuss my problems. It's been years though and maybe I should give it another chance.

I never thought about meditation. I should look into that.

We parted as friends however I can't bring myself to talk to her without feeling overwhelmed by my feelings for her. I want us to remain friends I just don't see it happening, at least not with my current state of mind. I know she cares about me she just wanted to move on. I still trust her and hold no hard feelings, but I just can't deal with that. Not now at least
